conclusion: Mixture: structural ownership ambiguity plus actual missing repair recognition/provenance in this cohort. No case has an observed downstream notice that could alone explain the typed miss.

field_ownership.gold: C5B expected_typed_decision is independently authored and C5C compares it literally; existing scores remain immutable.
field_ownership.native_notice: QueryPlan.public corrections/notice and interaction_for correction choices; assessment label alone is not wired as a native response field.
field_ownership.notice_policy: execution_policy infers notice from repairs/corrections/unknown_subject even when typed decision is EXECUTABLE.
field_ownership.typed_decision: QueryPlan.decision via decide(). Enum accepts notice, but the current SMART composer has no typed-notice producer.

native_limit: Static reachability traced; no native UI/API behavior newly executed. Do not claim a new measured native notice count.

proposed_contract_specification.affected_fields: Specify field-family vs endpoint codes with source operator/span evidence; do not equate rating to both endpoints unconditionally.
proposed_contract_specification.intent_priority: Independently specify author+title intent ownership; both extracted operands and retrieval behavior must be retained. No retrospective override.
proposed_contract_specification.no_blanket_equivalence: Never map every EXECUTABLE to EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE, and never equate a notice with refusal.
proposed_contract_specification.notice_success: Requires correct supported interpretation, traceable repair/advisory evidence and an actually observable required notice; AUTO_EXECUTE does not satisfy it.
proposed_contract_specification.parser_accuracy: Keep literal historical typed scores; decide independently whether future normative notice target belongs to parser or combined layers.
proposed_contract_specification.structured_advisory: Define typed level/length/purpose/subject preference slots with spans, required/advisory ownership, and absence vs unknown. Display strings alone cannot prove structured equality.
